paper_id: Wang et al. - 2016 - Every Packet Counts Loss and Reordering Identification and Its Application in Delay Measurement
title: Every Packet Counts: Loss and Reordering Identification and Its Application in Delay Measurement
motivation: 现有方法只能提供聚合延迟统计,在丢包或乱序时整组丢弃,无法捕捉细粒度延迟异常(如大延迟)
problem_framing: 在不改包前提下,通过识别丢包和乱序位置来恢复每个数据包的发送时间戳,从而计算per-packet延迟
key_insight: 网络中丢包和乱序数量远小于正常数据包,只需传输'小 ordering difference'而非全部可能的ordering
method_signature: OPA(顺序保持聚合器): augmented hash + 线性组合成CAH,receiver枚举丢失位置并用checking equation验证
evaluation_criteria: per-packet相对误差~2%,聚合延迟相对误差~10^-5,通信开销~10^-4,恢复率
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: 在10 Gbps高数据率下开销过高,只能在低数据率链路或离线分析中使用
evidence_for_taste: a single lost packet in a group cannot be calculated
the behavior of other protocols may be affected
large delays of interest may appear on a special set of packets
the overhead will be too high to run OPA online on the router
it is better to use OPA for low data rate link
thinking_moves: 将ordering recovery问题从通信角度重新建模:不传完整ordering,而传与发送ordering的small difference
利用网络数据的内在稀疏性(丢乱序少)来压缩信息表示
先用mapping equation求解,再用checking equation验证候选解的正确性
承认工程可行性限制:只在低数据率或离线场景实用,高数据率需future work
